comment: Failed explicit reconciliation follows the pinned SDK PendingCommandSet settlement rule: code -32030 OR kind commandRejected is a durable rejection; other admission/envelope failures admit nothing but remain held/unknown. A recorded ACK outranks either rejection signal.

cases.name: durable commandRejected code and kind settle
durable code signal settles even when the kind disagrees
durable kind signal settles even when the code disagrees
invalidParams admits nothing but does not settle
overloaded is retryable nothing-admitted, not settlement
backpressured is retryable nothing-admitted, not settlement
transport failure after admission stays unknown
recorded ACK outranks a later non-settling error
recorded ACK outranks even a rejection signal
